entry.title: MongoDB Not in a Rush to Find CEO Successor, Ittycheria Says
entry.summary: MongoDB Interim President and CEO Dev Ittycheria discusses the outlook for the company after Meta Platforms tapped former CEO Chirantan “CJ” Desai to lead a new AI platform for enterprise customers. He speaks on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
